role: Software & Services Marketing Operations & AI Leader
headline: AI use cases that ship and get adopted, on top of one trusted view of marketing and commercial performance.
pitch: I turn AI into working tools that teams actually use, and I build the data foundation those tools depend on. At flyExclusive I engineered an LLM pipeline wired into the CRM that enriches records, writes personalized outreach, and scores leads; built AI proposal and agreement tools the sales team uses to produce approved documents at scale; and built conversational reporting so teams can ask questions of the data directly. Underneath that, I led a HubSpot Enterprise transformation (governance, data standards, deduplication, Master Data Management) and redesigned the attribution and performance dashboards leadership reviews. I've run several of these programs at once while also serving as interim manager of a ~$10M/month sales team. I'm based in Raleigh, one of the role's listed locations, and I have an M.S. in Data Science.

requirements.need: AI acumen: translate AI capabilities into practical business use cases and measurable outcomes
requirements.evidence: At flyExclusive I've shipped several AI use cases into daily work: an autonomous LLM enrichment pipeline connected to the CRM that generates personalized subject lines and openers and powers lead scoring; AI proposal and agreement tools for the sales team; and conversational reporting interfaces. On this site I built a retrieval-augmented chat with an automated eval harness that checks grounding and refusals. I build with Claude Code and MCP servers every day.

requirements.need: Define and drive the AI roadmap: productivity, customer insights, content, personalization, decision-making
requirements.evidence: My AI work at flyExclusive already spans those categories: content and personalization (LLM-written outreach), decision-making (lead scoring, the competitive-pricing app that set 2026 pricing), productivity (proposal and agreement tools), and insights (conversational reporting). I've also built agentic systems (a LangGraph agent) and local LLM deployments outside work.

requirements.need: Unified data and analytics framework with trusted reporting and end-to-end performance visibility
requirements.evidence: I led flyExclusive's CRM data transformation (governance, scalable architecture, deduplication, MDM) to create a single source of truth, and built attribution frameworks and funnel dashboards that show marketing's contribution through to revenue. On this site, one channel definition is enforced in code and every report reads from it.

requirements.need: Integrated dashboards and analytics across the portfolio
requirements.evidence: Redesigned flyExclusive's retail performance dashboards for leadership; Tableau and Power BI; SQL, Python, and Databricks. At TRANZACT I ran multi-touch attribution and forecasting with commercial and finance leadership.

requirements.need: Scalable operating models, governance, data standards, and processes
requirements.evidence: I designed and enforced flyExclusive's CRM governance (properties, required fields, ownership rules, lifecycle stages) and onboarded 10 sales reps and 5 marketers onto the standards. At TRANZACT I set up the A/B testing framework and continuous-improvement protocols (50% test win rate, 30% CTR improvement).

requirements.need: Workflow automation and emerging technology for efficiency and scale
requirements.evidence: Automated enrichment and outreach drafting with LLMs, automated proposal generation, and consolidated the stack by replacing Tableau and Airtable. I'm now leading the replacement of HubSpot with an in-house tool. At TRANZACT I automated behavioral-data syncs into Iterable for 10+ lifecycle campaigns.

requirements.need: Lead large-scale cross-functional transformation with strong program management across multiple initiatives
requirements.evidence: In my first year at flyExclusive I ran a website migration, the HubSpot transformation, two tool replacements, and the AI sales tools in parallel across marketing, sales, and leadership, and now the HubSpot-to-in-house migration. These were company-wide for a fast-growing business, not global-enterprise scale.

requirements.need: Executive presence; influence stakeholders across a global, matrixed organization
requirements.evidence: I've presented recommendations to commercial and finance leadership at TRANZACT and aligned C-suite stakeholders at OnPoint. I haven't worked in a global matrix yet; I'd start by mapping owners and decision rights across the Software & Services regions.

requirements.need: Significant experience; software, SaaS, or services background preferred
requirements.evidence: Six years across marketing, CRM analytics, and AI, in private aviation and insurance rather than software. I bring the hands-on side the posting asks to measure: AI adoption, data quality, and automation I built myself.

featured.blurb: Retrieval-augmented chat over one source of truth, served server-side, with an automated eval harness for grounding and refusals. How I'd make AI trustworthy enough to adopt.

items: Meet Marketing, Commercial Ops, RevOps, Digital, IT, and Customer Success leads; list every transformation program with its owner, milestone, and status.
Map the systems and data sources behind Software & Services reporting, and where definitions conflict between teams and regions.
Collect AI ideas already in flight or requested, and baseline the time teams spend on manual reporting and content work.
Publish one program dashboard (priorities, milestones, owners, risks) and a monthly review cadence with leadership.
Agree shared metric definitions and data standards, and start a data-quality scorecard.
Prioritize the AI roadmap by value and effort, and launch two pilots with clear success measures (for example, content drafting and insight summaries on pipeline data).
Ship the first integrated performance dashboard across the portfolio.
Report AI pilot results (hours saved, adoption, quality) and decide which to scale globally, with training and governance.
Roll out standardized processes and templates for the next wave of automation.
